reason: As written the falsifier does not discriminate. (1) Vacuous threshold: pilot (experiments/MP-complexity-3/pilot_fft_bias.py, exact FFT triple-correlation, p=2^14..2^16, 60 random deg-d Legendre predicates per d) gives max conditional |bias|*sqrt(p)/d = 0.001-0.025, i.e. ~300x below the pass line 6; random predicates sit at the ~1/p null floor, so prediction_if_true is satisfied by pure noise and the metric would pass for a theorem that is true-but-loose or for no structure at all. No null/positive control arm. (2) Confound: marginal bias of Legendre(f(x)) is itself a Weil sum ~d/sqrt p (pilot marginal*sqrt(p)/d = 0.9 at d=1), so uncentred 'bias of pi(P+Q) given pi(P),pi(Q)' measures marginal imbalance, not simulability; must be centred on the marginal / compared with the independent-coin product. (3) 'Best-of-200 random f' cannot find the dangerous predicates, which are structured, not random: on any curve with a rational 2-torsion point e1, Legendre(x-e1) is the Kummer/2-descent homomorphism E(F_p)->{+-1}, degree d=1, pi(P+Q)=pi(P)pi(Q), bias 1 independent of p; the same holds for cubic/l-th power residue of x-e_i when l | #E. Toy curves must be prime order (the n=131 target) or this refutes the theorem trivially for a reason irrelevant to the target; the idea must state the prime-order (no small quotient) hypothesis. (4) Statement scope: 'S' is unspecified; for arbitrary S with d=1, S=x({kG: k<N/2}) is a DL-MSB oracle, so the theorem is false unless S is restricted to a class with bounded Fourier/character L1 norm (multiplicative characters, intervals). The test only covers Legendre so it cannot support 'closes polynomial x-filters' (KN-OPEN-91d4f6). (5) Only one 3-term relation P+Q tested; the hybrid needs joint law over q points and general linear forms aP+bQ(+cR), adaptivity. (6) Scaling: p in 2^16..2^20 only (4x in sqrt p); the headline regime d>=p^eps is invisible (p^eps<=4 at eps=0.1). Toy can test only the per-query exponent in p (-1/2 vs 0) and in d, not the T=p^{1/2-eps} conclusion; no bearing on n=131 beyond that exponent, and the model is GGM+predicate, not an actual ECDLP algorithm. Runnable: yes, exact computation is feasible (enumerate E(F_p) cyclic prime order via k*G, FFT convolution, O(N log N), seconds at 2^16, minutes at 2^20); sampling pairs would be infeasible (noise 1/sqrt(M) >> signal). Metric is a structural/information quantity (exact bias), not wall time: fine.
fix: Redesign: (a) PRIME-ORDER curves only (assert isprime(#E)), plus a POSITIVE CONTROL curve with rational 2-torsion using Legendre(x-e1) (expect bias 1, confirms harness detects live filters) and a NULL arm = random +-1 function on Z/N with matched marginal (expect ~1/N floor). (b) Compute exactly via dlog indexing g(k)=chi(f(x(kG))) and FFT: for cells (a,b) use conv(A,B)[c]*u[c]; report CENTRED statistic delta = P(out=1|a,b) - P(out=1) (and, for 3 relations, total-variation distance of the joint law (pi(P),pi(Q),pi(P+Q)) from product of marginals). (c) Replace pass line with a fitted exponent: regress log max delta on log p and log d over p=2^14..2^22 (N^2 never enumerated; FFT of 2^22 is seconds) with >=5 p-values and d in {1,2,3,4,6,8,16,32}; true=>slope in p <= -1/2 (observe ~ -1 for random f), live filter=>slope ~0. Report ratio to the null arm, not to d/sqrt p. (d) Adversarial search instead of random: for each d optimise f (hill-climb / exhaustive over small d and small p, plus structured families f=(x-e)^k, f dividing division polys psi_l, f=x^3+ax+b composites, f = resultant-derived x(P+T) rational maps, f from endomorphism/isogeny kernels) maximising delta; plus non-Legendre S (interval, additive characters e(ax), cubic residue) to check the S-class restriction. (e) Test general linear forms (a,b,a+-b, 2a+b, 3-point P+Q+R) and joint law of k=3..6 queries via multi-dim FFT or Monte-Carlo on the cyclic group. (f) Add explicit statement fix: restrict S to multiplicative-character/interval sets, prime-order group, and state that arbitrary S encodes DL bits. (g) Scaling claim stays theory: toy checks exponents only; state that d>=p^eps regime and n=131 are not probed; classify idea as relabelling/accounting (a GGM-simulation bound, no wall bypassed) unless a non-GGM-computable predicate is exhibited. Counted quantity = exact statistical distance, not time; cpu ~10 min at p<=2^22.
